title: eval-set/1: what this repo holds of a held-out eval set: the Role and Intent it tests, the count of cases, and each case's id and the sha256 of its file in the private home. A gate set says so, and of each case whether it is natural: a fresh set the gate reads, whose report is of counts alone (issue 612). No case content is here, and none may be.

gate.description: Whether this is a gate set, whose report is eval-aggregate/1, of counts alone; absent, a development set, whose report is eval-report/1.

natural.description: Whether the case was taken from a change as it was made, or built for the set: counted apart in a gate set's report, and never given to the Role.
